records.description: Federal Public Service Commission Consolidated Advertisement No. 4/2026 (Phase-4/2026), dated 6 Nov 2026: 48 cases, BS-16 to BS-20, in federal ministries and departments. Headline case: 160 Assistant Audit Officer (BS-17) posts, Office of the Auditor General of Pakistan, Case F.4-195/2026-R. Written screening test (MCQs) tentatively from 2 Jan 2027. Verification note: the FPSC homepage was reachable on 11 Nov 2026, but the Ad 4/2026 PDF itself was not directly opened in this check — the figures below were cross-checked across multiple independent reproductions of the official scanned advertisement, including page 12 (Case F.4-195/2026-R). The 278 total is the sum of the 48 cases; FPSC does not print a total in the ad. One listing gave 279 — not used. Always confirm your case, qualification and quota in the official ad on fpsc.gov.pk before applying.
records.education: Post-wise: Second Class / Grade C Master's or Bachelor's, MBBS, BE, or equivalent, per case
records.howToApply: Apply online only at fpsc.gov.pk (General Recruitment — Apply Online) before Mon 23 Nov 2026. Select your case number, generate the PSID and pay the fee via 1-Link before the closing date. No hard copy required.
records.requirements: 48 cases, ~278 posts, BS-16 to BS-20. Headline: Assistant Audit Officer (BS-17), Office of the Auditor General, Case F.4-195/2026-R — 160 posts, permanent. Qualification: Master's in Business Administration (Finance/Accounting), Economics, Mathematics, Commerce or Statistics, OR Master's with ICMA 1-year postgraduate certificate / CA (Foundation) / ACCA (knowledge level), with SAS/PIPFA confirmation; OR Bachelor's with PIPFA (Public Sector) / SAS qualified and 3 years' service. Age 22-30 years plus 5 years general relaxation. Other cases include Demonstrator (BS-17, 25 posts), Professor/Associate Professor, Chief Psychologist, Research Officers, Deputy/Assistant Chiefs and more — check your case in the official ad. Fee: Rs 600 (BS-16/17), Rs 1,500 (BS-18), Rs 2,500 (BS-19), Rs 3,000 (BS-20+) via PSID / 1-Link.
records.salary: BS-16 to BS-20, as per federal pay scales

records.description: The Staff Welfare Organization, under the Establishment Division, is hiring for seven posts in Quetta — and every one of them is reserved for Balochistan-domicile candidates. There is one Instructor post for someone with shorthand and typing speed, two Driver posts, and three Chowkidar and one Farash post for primary-pass applicants. It is a small, straightforward advertisement: apply online through the National Job Portal, then turn up for a walk-in interview in Quetta on 26 or 27 November. No written test, no fee, and no direct applications to the organisation. Verification note: the ad itself gives the deadline only as 15 days from its 4 November publication, which works out to 19 November; one listing gives 17 November instead, so check the date on NJP before you apply.
records.experience: Instructor: 3 years' experience as a typist. Driver: valid driving licence.
records.howToApply: Apply online only through the National Job Portal at njp.gov.pk within 15 days of the advertisement's publication (by 19 Nov 2026). Age 18-25 years for Instructor, Chowkidar and Farash, and 18-30 years for Driver, plus age relaxation per government rules. Balochistan domicile required.

records.description: The Office of the Wafaqi Mohtasib — the Federal Ombudsman — has one opening at its Regional Office in Quetta, for a Chowkidar on the regular BPS-01 scale. It is a primary-pass post, and it sits under the 6% Balochistan quota, so applicants need a Balochistan domicile or a valid residence certificate. There is no written test: shortlisted candidates are called for a walk-in interview, and you take your original documents and domicile certificate with you. Apply online through the National Job Portal before 23 November. Verification note: the NJP listing itself gives two different wordings for the age limit — its description says 18 to 35 including relaxations, while its overview box says maximum 30 with federal relaxation rules — so check your eligibility on the listing itself before applying. One aggregator also gives the last date as 24 November; the NJP listing's own figure, 23 November, is used here.
records.howToApply: Apply online only through the National Job Portal at njp.gov.pk before 23 Nov 2026 (direct listing: njp.gov.pk/index.php/jobs/10626). Government servants must apply through the proper channel after obtaining an NOC. Only shortlisted candidates are called for walk-in interviews; no TA/DA. Bring original documents and your domicile or valid residence certificate, with attested copies, to the interview.
